picks.headline: Anthropic Launches Claude Gov Models for Classified US National Security Use
picks.why: Anthropic is deploying custom Claude variants directly into classified government environments for national security operations.
picks.title: Claude Gov models for US national security

picks.headline: Google Cloud and NVIDIA Announce GA of Vera Rubin NVL72 Infrastructure
picks.why: Next-generation A5X cloud instances bring NVIDIA's Vera Rubin architecture to market for large-scale RL and agentic workloads.
picks.title: Google Cloud and NVIDIA Announce General Availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin Infrastructure

picks.headline: Google and Meta Release TorchTPU for Native PyTorch Execution on TPUs
picks.why: TorchTPU enables standard PyTorch code and torch.compile to run natively on Google Cloud TPUs without custom XLA wrappers.
picks.title: Introducing TorchTPU

picks.headline: Anthropic Expands Project Glasswing Vulnerability Scanning to 150 Organizations
picks.why: Deploys Claude Mythos Preview across high-impact global software infrastructure to proactively identify zero-day vulnerabilities.
picks.title: Expanding Project Glasswing

picks.headline: Carryover Attacks Benchmark Reveals Long-Term Memory Vulnerability in LLM Agents
picks.why: Demonstrates that indirect prompt injections stored in agent memory re-trigger across future sessions without signal decay.
picks.title: After the Attacker Leaves: Benchmarking Carryover Attacks on LLM Agents

picks.headline: NVIDIA Introduces Sentry Framework for Runtime Security of AI Agents
picks.why: Delivers out-of-reach runtime isolation and monitoring to prevent autonomous agents from altering security controls or escalating privileges.
picks.title: Inside NVIDIA Sentry: Secure AI Agents at Runtime

picks.headline: Anthropic Releases Compliance Framework for California SB 53 Legislation
picks.why: Establishes an industry model for mandatory public disclosure and risk assessment ahead of California's frontier AI law.
picks.title: Our compliance framework for California's SB 53

papers.headline: Study Shows Static Active Expert Reduction Outperforms Dynamic MoE Skipping
papers.why: Demonstrates that complex dynamic expert skipping algorithms rarely beat simply lowering active experts statically when controlled for compute budget.
papers.title: Don't Skip the Baseline: A Controlled Comparison of Dynamic Expert Skipping in MoEs

papers.headline: Specter Accelerates Single-GPU MoE Inference via Multi-Step Speculative Offloading
papers.why: Uses a quantized draft model to prefetch host-offloaded experts over PCIe before token verification, alleviating host memory bandwidth limits.
papers.title: Specter: Fast MoE Inference via Quantization-Enabled Multi-Step Speculative Offloading

papers.headline: RACE Prunes RoPE Rotary Pairs to Compress KV-Cache Without Retraining
papers.why: Introduces a post-training compression method that prunes RoPE pairs by activation energy, natively reducing KV-cache memory and attention compute.
papers.title: RACE: RoPE-Aligned Attention Compression Based on Query-Key Activation Energies
